# Extra Scoop Documentation

> Extra Scoop is an institutional media network bridging eyewitnesses on the ground with broadcast newsrooms through hardware-backed capture, automated authenticity verification, and cryptographic licensing.

## Platform Summary

Extra Scoop establishes an unbroken chain of custody for breaking news dispatches:
* **Eyewitness Mobile App:** An iOS and Android application enabling citizens and field reporters to record verified footage, preserve camera metadata, negotiate commercial licences in real time, and receive instant bank payouts.
* **Newsroom Terminal:** A multi-stream desktop intelligence desk for wire editors to monitor incoming dispatches, inspect verification signals, acquire exclusive broadcast rights, and export packages directly to broadcast CMS systems.

## Core Concepts

* **[Silicon Trust™ Architecture](/concepts/silicon-trust):** Multi-stage integrity pipeline incorporating synthetic-media screening, neural watermarking, C2PA manifest injection, and the Provenance Invariance raw file purge guarantee.
* **[Digital Deeds & Provenance](/concepts/digital-deeds):** Standardised ownership instruments anchored to the Base layer-2 blockchain and decentralised IPFS storage, providing legal indemnity and transparent commercial terms.
* **[Trust Scores & Verification](/concepts/trust-scores):** Dynamic credibility ratings computed from hardware attestation, temporal/spatial consistency, synthetic-media analysis, and creator track record.
* **[Smart Escrow & Settlement](/concepts/smart-escrow):** Automated settlement engine locking newsroom funds (£5.00 min to £1,000,000.00 max) and executing instant payout upon licence acceptance.

## Eyewitness Mobile App

* **[Quickstart Guide](/eyewitness/quickstart):** Installation, security PIN setup, biometric authentication, source privacy controls, and reporting personas (Witness, Field Reporter, Truth Seeker).
* **[Capturing Verified Footage](/eyewitness/capturing-footage):** In-app camera recording, sensor metadata extraction, location verification, and LocalForage offline queueing.
* **[The Dealroom & Bidding](/eyewitness/dealroom-bidding):** Reviewing incoming newsroom offers, evaluating exclusive versus syndication licences, countering bids, and accepting terms.
* **[Payouts & Stripe Connect](/eyewitness/payouts-stripe):** Connecting bank accounts, tracking available balances and lifetime earnings, and executing automated transfers via Stripe Connect.
* **[Ephemeral E2EE Messenger](/eyewitness/ephemeral-messenger):** Source confidentiality channel engineered with ML-KEM 768 (Kyber) post-quantum key encapsulation, RSA-OAEP 2048, AES-GCM 256, Apple Secure Enclave P-256 signatures, RAM-only session storage, and deterministic memory noise wiping.

## Newsroom Terminal

* **[Terminal Overview](/terminal/overview):** High-speed desktop command centre featuring Workspace Columns, Grid Feed, and Deed Vault modes.
* **[Workspace Columns & Search](/terminal/workspace-columns):** Multi-stream feed organisation, OmniCommand bar, Boolean query syntax (`AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, `trust:>N`, `#hashtag`), and sonar acoustic radar alerts.
* **[Concord Dealroom & Licensing](/terminal/concord-dealroom):** Evaluating verification reports, placing commercial bids, negotiating counter-proposals, and executing smart escrow locks.
* **[The Deed Vault](/terminal/deed-vault):** Permanent legal and compliance archive for inspecting cryptographic anchors, verifying Base layer-2 receipts, and downloading high-resolution master files.
* **[Wire Format Exporter](/terminal/wire-exporter):** 1-click broadcast package export formatted for IPTC NewsML-G2 XML (compatible with BBC ENPS, AP Newsroom, Reuters Connect) and newsroom CMS JSON webhooks.

## Developer Hub

* **[API Authentication](/developer/api-authentication):** Authenticating programmatic requests using Bearer JWT tokens with runnable cURL, TypeScript, and Python examples.
* **[Webhooks Integration](/developer/webhooks):** Real-time event subscriptions (`escrow.locked`, `deed.anchored`, `media.ready`, `scoop.verified`) with timing-safe HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.
* **[Errors & Rate Limits](/developer/errors-and-limits):** Standard HTTP response codes, error payloads, and API tier rate limits.

## Key Terminology

* **Silicon Trust™:** Layered provenance framework combining synthetic-media screening, hardware attestation, and signed manifests.
* **Digital Deed:** Immutable ownership certificate anchored on Base layer-2 and decentralised storage.
* **Trust Score:** Dynamic reputation rating evaluating capture integrity, hardware signals, and media authenticity.
* **Provenance Invariance:** Security guarantee ensuring that unwatermarked raw source assets are permanently purged from public access once protected.
* **Concord Dealroom:** Institutional transaction desk for commercial bidding and media licensing.
* **Blind ID:** Cryptographically masked identifier protecting contributor identity while maintaining reputational continuity.
